components.name: Setup action
components.description: The only primary action on the page.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 550 15px InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; color: white; background: var(--green); min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--green-hover); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Source citation
components.description: A timestamp opens its source passage.
components.css: .ds-citation { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 6px; font: 500 13px/1.5 monospace; color: var(--green); background: var(--selected); border-radius: 3px; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-citation:hover { color: white; background: var(--green); } .ds-citation:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Native disclosure
components.description: Secondary text is available on demand, without JavaScript.
components.html:
View setup instructions

Copy the setup prompt into your existing agent.
components.css: .ds-details { color: var(--ink); font: 15px/1.65 InterVariable, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-details summary { color: var(--muted); min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 0; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; } .ds-details summary:hover { color: var(--green); } .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The user rejected the previous site's complexity and noisy copy. Keep the established cool paper, navy text, green actions, and condensed display face; remove competing demonstrations and secondary surfaces. Show one task and its useful answer. Evidence stays inspectable without being permanently on screen.
dos: Do explain one concrete use case before offering more choices.
Do keep exact source quotes and required limitations available.
Do make the next action obvious and singular.
donts: Don't restore the source sidebar, mode tabs, repeated marketing sections, or inline command catalog.
Don't remove provenance labels to achieve a smaller word count.
